change_request: We need to extend the account identifier field to support longer account numbers for the new branch integration.
resolution_notes: The phrase 'account identifier field' maps to ACCT-ID (PIC 9(11)) in CVACT01Y/ACCOUNT-RECORD as the primary account key. Aliases confirmed in copybooks: CARD-ACCT-ID (CVACT02Y, card's account FK), XREF-ACCT-ID (CVACT03Y, xref's account FK), CDEMO-ACCT-ID (COCOM01Y commarea, carries the account ID between CICS programs), CC-ACCT-ID/CC-ACCT-ID-N (CVCRD01Y, working-area display and REDEFINES pair), TRANCAT-ACCT-ID (CVTRA01Y, transaction category balance record key). Excluded near-miss: CUST-EFT-ACCOUNT-ID (CVCUS01Y, PIC X(10)) — this is a customer EFT bank-account number, a different domain and different shape. CBTRN03C COPYs CVACT03Y (active) so it's a candidate. CBSTM03A COPYs CVACT01Y and CVACT03Y (active). All 27 candidates are core module only per user scope instruction.
